_about: 전투 연출에 겹쳐 띄우는 효과 그림(2026-11-24). 검은 바탕에 그려 받아, 밝기를 투명도로 바꿔(luma) 오른쪽 아래 Gemini 워터마크를 거꾸로 계산해 지운 뒤 img/fx/<id>.webp(투명 WebP, 긴 변 384px)로 넣는다(python3 tools/art/fx_import.py). 게임(js/fxart.js)은 이 그림을 띄웠다가(투명도 · 크기 · 자리만 움직임) 사라지게 한다 — 무거운 흐림 · 입자 대신. 프롬프트는 build 없이 gen_fx_overlays.js 가 이 파일에서 바로 만든다.
lead: Square 1:1 painting of a single game visual-effect element, isolated in the centre of a pure flat black background (#000000) with wide empty black margins on every side — it will be cut out by brightness and layered over a dark battlefield as a glowing overlay.
leadWeapon: Square 1:1 painting of one spectral weapon, shown in exact side view in the centre, aimed straight at the RIGHT edge — its barrel, bolt or arrow horizontal with the tip pointing right — isolated on a pure flat black background (#000000) with wide empty black margins on every side — it will be cut out by brightness and float over a dark battlefield like a translucent apparition.
light: The subject glows from within: its brightest edges and core are near-white, its colour falls off smoothly into the black, and its darkest parts melt into the background.
style: ETHERION effect art — painterly dark-fantasy illustration: confident visible brushwork, luminous colour, a crisp shape that reads at small size. Painting only, no lettering, no frame, no ground or scenery.
saveAs: Save the image file as: {file} — this is the name of the downloaded file only; the painting itself stays wordless.

items.scene: A short, brutal matchlock hand-cannon: a flared bronze muzzle, a barrel banded with brass rings, a stock of basalt-black wood split by thin magma-orange seams. A smouldering slow-match glows in the serpentine lock and a few embers curl from the touch-hole. Fire-orange (#ff6b3d) light runs along its edges.

A heavy riveted steel arbalest: thick steel limbs, a cranked windlass at the back, a square-headed steel bolt loaded in the groove. Cold blue-grey steel (#a9b4c2) with crisp white highlights on every rivet and a faint forge-orange glow in the joints.

A copper coil rifle: a long copper barrel wrapped in tight coils, three small glass jars of captive lightning set along its spine, a fork of electricity crackling just past the muzzle. Searing electric yellow (#ffd84a) arcs leap between the coils.

A great hunting bow of horn and bone held upright, its grip wrapped in rawhide and bone beads, the string drawn back with a heavy flint-headed arrow nocked and pointing right. Dry ochre (#b88a5a) dust glows along the bone and drifts from the string.

A living bow grown from a single curved branch, held upright, moss and small leaves sprouting along its limbs, a string of twisted vine drawn back with a long thorn arrow nocked and pointing right. Leaf-green (#58b85f) light pulses through its grain.

A crossbow of pale coral and mother-of-pearl, its loaded bolt a spiral harpoon made of clear living water with a ring of foam at the tip. Water-blue (#4fb3ff) light ripples along the coral like sound made visible.
A black obsidian crossbow bound with fine chains and two dark-red wax seals, its loaded bolt a sliver of condensed shadow trailing violet smoke. Luminous violet (#8b5cf6) edges outline the obsidian.

A white-gold longbow held upright, its two limbs shaped like outstretched feathered wings, the string drawn back with an arrow made of a single solid sunbeam nocked and pointing right. Pale gold (#ffe9a8) radiance spills from the feathers.

A long, elegant silver elven longbow held upright, slender limbs engraved with tiny star charts, the taut string drawn back with a feather-fletched arrow nocked and pointing right, thin ribbons of wind spiralling around the shaft. Wind-teal (#9fe3d6) and silver light.

A protective barrier seen front-on: a round shield-dome of ice-blue light (#9be8ff) built from interlocking hexagonal rune panes, its rim brightest, a soft ripple spreading across it as if just struck.
A blessing sigil seen front-on: a radiant circle of pale-gold light with a ring of small upturned feathers of light around it and a faint vertical beam rising from its centre.
A healing bloom seen from slightly above: soft green (#7fe39c) light opening like a flower, small leaves and petals of light spiralling gently upward from its heart, warm and calm.

Empowerment: a glowing rune circle on the floor seen at a low angle, a tall column of golden (#ffd27a) light rising from it, small rune glyph shapes and bright sparks streaming upward inside the column.
A weakening curse: heavy chains of violet-black smoke coiling downward around an empty centre, a cracked dark sigil beneath them glowing thin violet at its cracks, the whole shape sinking.
A blood price: a round sigil like a pressed wax seal glowing crimson (#e0344a), droplets of blood orbiting it in a slow ring, thin red light dripping from its lower edge.
The instant a cannon shell bursts: a round explosion of fire-orange (#ff6b3d) flame with a white-hot core, jagged shards and embers flung outward, curls of black powder smoke at its rim.
A falling meteor: a glowing molten rock plunging diagonally from the upper left toward the lower right, a long tail of flame and embers streaming behind it, its leading face white-hot.
A spray of steel: a fan of sharp steel blades and rivets bursting outward from a bright point, each shard catching cold blue-grey (#a9b4c2) light with white glints, faint orange sparks between them.
A lightning strike: a forked bolt of searing electric yellow (#ffd84a) slamming straight down into a burst of sparks, thin branching arcs crawling outward from the point of impact.
An earth eruption: a jagged fissure tearing open with shards of rock and a plume of ochre (#b88a5a) dust bursting upward, the cracks glowing faintly from within.
A thorn eruption: thick vines covered in long thorns lashing upward and outward from one point, leaves torn loose around them, leaf-green (#58b85f) light glowing along the vines.
A cresting wave: a curling wall of clear water-blue (#4fb3ff) water breaking from left to right, foam and pearl-like droplets flying from its crest, light shining through the water.
Shadow claws: three long curved claw-marks of black shadow ripping diagonally across the space, their edges burning luminous violet (#8b5cf6), wisps of dark smoke trailing from each stroke.
A spear of light: a solid lance of pale-gold (#ffe9a8) sunlight driving straight down, a ring of radiant light bursting where its point lands, small feathers of light scattering.
Wind blades: three thin crescent blades of wind-teal (#9fe3d6) air slicing across the space from left to right, silver streaks and a few drifting feathers caught in their wake.
A volley of arrows: a dense rain of glowing arrows streaking diagonally down from the upper left toward the lower right, wind-teal (#9fe3d6) light trailing behind each shaft.
